heading: EXT. SPARKLE AUTO SPA CAR WASH - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. SPARKLE AUTO SPA CAR WASH - NIGHT
Neon pink.
A conveyor belt rumbles through a tunnel of foaming brushes.
A dented sedan idles at the entrance, hazards blinking.
VINNIE CASTELLANOS, 40s, leather jacket, keys in one fist, slams the sedan's trunk.
LUCKY SZYMANSKI, 30s, kneels by the front tire, holding a duffel bag.
A police radio on Vinnie's belt crackles.
All units, shots fired at Third and Maple. Suspects in a gray sedan.
units.name: SGT. HAYES

units.text: Too soon.
units.name: VINNIE

units.text: We gotta go, Vin.
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: Wait for Dee.
units.name: VINNIE

units.text: Dee's three minutes late.
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: She's two minutes late. Don't--
units.name: VINNIE

units.text: DEE OKPARA, 30s, black hoodie, running shoes, bursts around the corner of the tunnel with a gym bag clutched to her chest.
Go, go, go!
units.name: DEE

units.text: You're late!
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: I was shot at!
units.name: DEE

units.text: By who?
units.name: VINNIE

units.text: By whoever I robbed, Vinnie, who do you think?
units.name: DEE

units.text: Units responding to Third and Maple. Repeat, gray sedan, plates unknown.
units.name: SGT. HAYES

units.text: Vinnie rips the radio off his belt and drops it into the car-wash foam.
Dee dives into the back seat.
Lucky tosses the duffel in after her and slides behind the wheel.
Vin, door!
units.name: LUCKY

units.text: I'm getting in!
units.name: VINNIE

units.text: The sedan lurches forward onto the belt.
Brushes descend.
Water sprays across the windshield.
Inside, three people sit very still, breathing hard, as the car wash whirls around them and a siren grows in the distance.
This is the worst getaway ever.
units.name: DEE

units.text: It's a very good wash.
units.name: LUCKY
